text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the Fan Fest over, our usual<n>training
schedule resumes. One<n>evening, I head back to
the academy,<n>driven by a sense of unease I can't
quite place...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Only to see Rudolf standing alone on<n>the training
track.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Tears trickle down her cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry that you had to see that. I<n>should know
that bitter tears are no<n>good to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I know now is the time to pick myself<n>up and keep
moving forwards. I<n>know... and yet here I am,
wallowing<n>in self-pity.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I do not deserve to call myself the<n>Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I realize instantly that she's talking<n>about her poor
performance at the<n>Fan Fest.
choice_data_list: You were just tired, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That's not it, Trainer. I am not judging<n>myself
merely by one race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This failure was the culmination of all<n>of my deeds
prior to this point.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That is why it stings so fiercely.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have pushed myself to forge<n>furiously ahead in
order to realize my<n>vision.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have not hesitated to unfairly<n>impose my will on
those around me if<n>it would achieve my dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I implored them to believe in the<n>Emperor's
strength. I assured them<n>that I would lead them to
bliss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And where did all of that lead me? To<n>the
shameful display you witnessed<n>the other day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
All the victories I have won so far will<n>be worth
nothing if I stop now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: My dreams lie in the future, after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And yet, I've come to a halt.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
All of my supposed majesty was<n>exposed as
falsehood under the<n>bright light of day.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
What the heck was that? Isn't she<n>supposed to
be the Emperor?

text_block_list.name: Student Spectators
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen the President run so<n>slow... What
happened?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I disappointed everybody who came<n>to watch me
race, yourself included.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, worse—I betrayed them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I was never qualified to be<n>the Emperor
in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She looks at me with anguish in her<n>eyes. For the
first time, I can feel<n>she's genuinely relying on me
and<n>my judgment.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And thanks to the path we've walked<n>together, I
know exactly what to say.
choice_data_list: You don't have to do anything.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?
choice_data_list: You're the Emperor, no question about it.
You're the Emperor, no question about it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But how can you say that? I<n>appreciate that you
are trying to<n>encourage me, but twisting the truth
isn't kindness.
choice_data_list: The proof is right in front of you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Right in front of me? What do you<n>mean?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
All this time, she's been laboring<n>under a flawed
understanding of<n>what the Emperor needs to be.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's true that the Emperor needs<n>strength, but it's
not the strength to<n>carry everyone's burdens
alone that<n>she needs—it's the strength to attract
and inspire others.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And the course Symboli Rudolf has<n>charted so far
has proven beyond<n>any doubt that she's capable
of that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Just then, the sound of countless<n>footsteps
reaches our ears.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President!

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Students
text_block_list.text: Preeeeez!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What? But... why are you all...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf lifts her head to see a<n>crowd of
Tracen Academy students<n>running toward her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but notice that you<n>were absent
from the student council<n>meeting today.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I started asking around to see where<n>you might
be, and... well, it turns out<n>that a great number of
students<n>wanted to help.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see. I'm sorry for the trouble.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If this is about role assignment, I can<n>have the
draft to you by—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That won't be necessary. I have<n>taken care of it
myself, more or less.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian will chair the event.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I keep telling you, you should do it.<n>I'm not much
of a speaker.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We have already discussed this. I will<n>have my
hands full as general<n>coordinator.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Both of those roles are usually mine.<n>Why would
you...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, I see. You've given up on me<n>after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You've concluded that following my<n>lead will not
guide you to bliss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Very well. If my people do not want<n>me, I shall
yield the thro—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We are simply doing what we think is<n>necessary,
nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I cannot possibly allow you to stand<n>on stage
when you are still<n>exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
After all, who else but the Emperor<n>will inspire us
to dream?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The dorm leaders will help pick up our<n>slack.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You got it! We'll be directin' the<n>crowds before
and after the event!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I asked my dear ponies to pitch in too,<n>and they all
happily agreed.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Anything for the President, they said!<n>You should
have seen how they<n>fought over who got to do
what!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Please, there's no need to go to so<n>much trouble...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trouble? Who said it was any<n>trouble?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
We all know you're out there busting<n>your butt for
us, President.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The whole class is psyched we finally<n>get to
return the favor. Whatever<n>needs doing, we'll
hop-hop right to it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And if you need any heavy lifting<n>done, just leave
it to me and these<n>guns! Look at 'em flex!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I... don't know what to say...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Has this reminded you yet, President?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We want to walk the path you<n>walk—chase the
dream you chase.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We don't just want to sit on our<n>hands and wait
for you to create a<n>world of bliss. We want to
seize it<n>with you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So please don't think of us as sheep<n>to be
protected.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We're fully capable of running on our<n>own two
feet!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You're right. I see now...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
How could I have forgotten?<n>Thoughtless barely
begins to cover<n>my behavior...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It seems I've gotten so used to<n>relying only on
myself, I forgot how to<n>lend an ear to those around
me.
choice_data_list: You should have more faith in them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I know.
choice_data_list: And in what you've accomplished so far.
And in what you've accomplished so far.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I know. I will.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Thank you, one and all...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf's eyes begin to<n>glisten once again.
But this time, it's<n>not tears that glimmer in her
eyes, but<n>the light of a firm will.
